introduction: Mississippi WIC supports eligible pregnant, breastfeeding or postpartum participants, infants and children younger than five.
description: Mississippi WIC supports eligible pregnant, breastfeeding or postpartum participants, infants and children younger than five.

sections.who: Residency, income and nutrition requirements apply. Ask the clinic how existing benefits affect the income screen.
sections.get: WIC offers supplemental foods, nutrition advice and breastfeeding support, using eWIC benefits.
sections.apply:
1. Prepare documents

    The online form cannot save a partly completed application.

  2. Start intake

    Use MSDH’s WIC application page, or call 800-338-6747 for a clinic appointment.

  3. Complete enrollment

    Follow the clinic’s nutrition assessment and document instructions.
sections.after: Learn the eWIC shopping rules and keep follow-up appointments.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using WIC application and documents. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
